newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Spot prices mostly lower.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Spot prices mostly lower.

text.p: U.S. millfeed prices were lower at several locations, pressured by recent declines in corn prices and an abundance of sorghum in the High Plains states, millfeed dealers said.
St Louis sources reported a $12 per ton drop in prices since Tuesday, with a few trades Wednesday at $83, versus offers of $95 Tuesday.
"It has been scary," the St Louis dealer said of the drop.
Interior Kansas dealers said millfeed offers dropped $4 since Tuesday because of lower corn and ample sorghum supplies.
"It's the corn market pulling all of the (feed) ingredients down," he said. Plus, sorghum is "definitely weighing on it."
